import cadquery as cq
import math

# === 参数 ===
top_d = 80       # 上口直径 (mm)
bottom_d = 15    # 下口直径 (mm)
cone_h = 60      # 锥部高度 (mm)
spout_h = 20     # 管口高度 (mm)
wall = 1.5       # 壁厚 (mm)

# === 建模 ===
# 锥形外壳（用旋转体）
pts = [
    (0, 0),
    (bottom_d / 2, 0),
    (top_d / 2, cone_h),
    (top_d / 2, cone_h + 5),
    (0, cone_h + 5),
]
outer = (
    cq.Workplane("XZ")
    .polyline(pts).close()
    .revolve(360)
)

# 内壁
pts_inner = [
    (0, wall),
    (bottom_d / 2 - wall, wall),
    (top_d / 2 - wall, cone_h),
    (top_d / 2 - wall, cone_h + 5),
    (0, cone_h + 5),
]
inner = (
    cq.Workplane("XZ")
    .polyline(pts_inner).close()
    .revolve(360)
)

# 管口
spout_outer = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .circle(bottom_d / 2)
    .extrude(-spout_h)
)
spout_inner = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .circle(bottom_d / 2 - wall)
    .extrude(-spout_h)
)

result = outer.cut(inner).union(spout_outer).cut(spout_inner)

show_object(result)
